subject: High correlations for level 2 variables in MSEM

messages.author: d20d1ffb95d401b6
messages.subject: High correlations for level 2 variables in MSEM
parts:
Hi everyone,

I recall from an SEM lecture series I watched that it is quite common to see very high correlations among items/constructs at level 2 of a multilevel model when level 2 variables are aggregates of level 1 variables (e.g., job satisfaction and engagement may be distinct at level 1, but not distinct at level 2). I was wondering if anyone knows any literature that mentions this tendency that I can cite to. 

Thanks!
